name: Phenax
description: A mortal soul who became the first to escape the Underworld through the Tartyx and ascended to godhood.

description_citations.text: "Underworld". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phenax warps the dryad Arasta into a monstrous spider creature.
timeline.quote: a dryad that was later warped and transformed into a monstrous spider creature by the bitter god Phenax

citation.text: "Dryad", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Returned escape the underworld via the Path of Phenax, losing their identities, and gather in the necropoleis.
timeline.quote: The necropoleis of Asphodel and Odunos house the Returned, undead beings who have escaped the underworld at the cost of their identities.

citation.text: "Mortal Realm", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Leonin destroy Iretis through the secret manipulations of Ashiok and Phenax.
timeline.quote: Destroyed by leonin thanks to the secret manipulations of Ashiok and Phenax

citation.text: "Oreskos", section "Locations in Oreskos's surroundings". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Originally a mortal trapped in the Underworld, Phenax hides from Erebos and Athreos by forsaking his identity and crosses back wrapped in Athreos's cloak, becoming the first Returned.
timeline.quote: This escape established his role as the first Returned and set him on the path to godhood.

citation.text: "Phenax", section "Underworld". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phenax covertly supports Xenagos's apotheosis to subvert divine authority.
timeline.quote: He covertly supported Xenagos's apotheosis

citation.text: "Phenax", section "Divine Relationships". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phenax makes a pact with Ashiok to lay waste to Iretis in exchange for hiding Ashiok from the other gods.
timeline.quote: Phenax made a pact with the nightmare planeswalker Ashiok

citation.text: "Phenax", section "Cooperation with Ashiok". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Silence of the Gods prevents Phenax from influencing mortal affairs.
timeline.quote: which prevented him from influencing mortal affairs during that period

citation.text: "Phenax", section "Silence of the Gods". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phenax is strongly implied to have cursed Xandria, turning her into a siren after she fell in love with Ninis.
timeline.quote: It is also strongly implied that Phenax was the god behind the curse

citation.text: "Phenax", section "Silence of the Gods". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phenax becomes the first mortal to escape the land of the dead by using the Tartyx's waters to strip himself of identity.
timeline.quote: Phenax was the first mortal to find a route of escape out of the land of the dead

citation.text: "Returned", section "Origins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Other denizens of the Underworld replicate his escape, some assisted by Phenax, creating the Returned.
timeline.quote: other denizens of the Underworld replicated his escape

citation.text: "Returned", section "Origins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashiok and Phenax plague Iretis and the leonin with nightmares until the leonin destroy the polis; Phenax claims it as a necropolis.
timeline.quote: Phenax then claimed Iretis as a new necropolis for his Returned.

citation.text: "Returned", section "Iretis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phenax, invisible in the throne room, watches the king of Iretis stab out both his own eyes after hearing of the murder of his wife and child.
timeline.quote: It was the second stab into his other eye, the mortal shrieking all the while, that Phenax found so impressive.

citation.text: "Building Toward a Dream, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The old man's illusion fades and reveals Ashiok.
timeline.quote: the old man's form began to waver and shimmer.

citation.text: "Building Toward a Dream, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Phenax confronts Ashiok about the deaths; Ashiok admits the story was invented but the family may die on the road.
timeline.quote: The story of their deaths I made up.

citation.text: "Building Toward a Dream, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Phenax warns Ashiok to show respect.
timeline.quote: Presume with me again, and I will erase you from existence.

citation.text: "Building Toward a Dream, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Ashiok reports that the leonin are sacking Iretis and that the city now belongs to Phenax.
timeline.quote: The leonin sacking of the city has already begun.

citation.text: "Building Toward a Dream, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Phenax asks Ashiok what boon is wanted; Ashiok reveals a love of making nightmares real.
timeline.quote: I have built a beautiful dream here in Iretis.

citation.text: "Building Toward a Dream, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Ashiok whispers a request to Phenax, who is surprised.
timeline.quote: You are sure, mortal? This is what you want?

citation.text: "Building Toward a Dream, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Phenax looks into Ashiok's essence, laughs, grants the wish and leaves.
timeline.quote: So be it, mortal. You shall have your wish.

citation.text: "Building Toward a Dream, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Phenax promises the newly dead they will be spared from Erebos.
timeline.quote: Phenax promised the newly dead souls they would be spared from Erebos.

citation.text: Black Oak of Odunos (Born of the Gods, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ashiok bargains with Phenax and seeks to incite war between Iretis and the leonin.
timeline.quote: they made a bargain with Phenax , the god of lies and deceit

citation.text: "Ashiok", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Posing as Udaen, Ashiok sends nightmare abominations to kill people at a peace meeting; the leonin annihilate Iretis, serving Phenax's plan, and Ashiok asks to be made invisible to the gods.
timeline.quote: The leonin retaliated by annihilating the Iretis' citizenry

citation.text: "Ashiok", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashiok, whose concealment from Phenax's boon fades, reveals that they sculpted the dreams to create the god Cacophony as a display, hiding in an abandoned Ephara temple.
timeline.quote: The earth's rumbles faded to stillness as the last remnant of Phenax's glamour dissolved around Ashiok.

citation.text: "Dreams of the City" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2014.

timeline.summary: Ashiok recalls repaying a favor to Phenax with a boon to hide from the gods, and Phenax's warning not to use it to harm a god.
timeline.quote: The boon was a temporary one, and Phenax had been very explicit about Ashiok's fate if Ashiok used the boon to attempt to injure or murder a god.

citation.text: "Dreams of the City" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2014.

timeline.summary: A satyr springs onto the path, tells Zosimos his mind's garden is full of weeds, and says worry is Phenax's creation that spurns Iroas.
timeline.quote: When you worry, you're actually worshipping Phenax.

citation.text: "The Path or the Horizon" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 May 2014.

timeline.summary: Transformed, Zosimos leaves the path to Meletis and follows a pull toward the eastern mountains, abandoning thoughts he calls the seeds of Phenax.
timeline.quote: Now he followed his destiny.

citation.text: "The Path or the Horizon" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 May 2014.

timeline.summary: Ashiok reveals themself as mastermind; Phenax claims Iretis for his Returned.
timeline.quote: Phenax would have the city to house his Returned

citation.text: "Kedarick VI", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The satyr teaches that worry is Phenax's creation and that worrying is a form of worship of him.
timeline.quote: Worrying was a form of worship of Phenax

citation.text: "Zosimos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phenax became the first mortal to escape the Underworld, and later a god.
timeline.quote: As a mortal, Phenax was the first to escape the Underworld.

citation.text: Minion's Return (Theros Beyond Death, 2020), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Phenax becomes the first mortal to escape the Underworld unnoticed by Athreos or Erebos.
timeline.quote: Phenax was the first mortal to escape the Underworld without drawing the notice of Athreos or Erebos

citation.text: "Odunos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phenax assembles Returned, conquers Odunos, slaughters the population and binds their souls to the Black Oak.
timeline.quote: conquered Odunos, slaughtering the population and binding their souls to the Black Oak

citation.text: "Odunos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tymaret witnesses Phenax's escape and informs Erebos, who lets him leave the Underworld as a Returned to catch Phenax.
timeline.quote: The only witness to Phenax's escape was Tymaret

citation.text: "Odunos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: According to a rarely whispered tale, Phenax was destined to free the Titans, so mortals killed him and the gods later allowed his escape.
timeline.quote: the gods later allowed his escape to protect themselves

citation.text: "Phenax", section "Phenax's Secret". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phenax becomes the first to escape the Underworld through the Tartyx and ascends to godhood.
timeline.quote: Once a mortal soul, Phenax became the first to escape the Underworld by journeying through the Tartyx River.

citation.text: "Underworld", section "Locations inside the Underworld". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashiok, aided by Phenax, nurses the polis's collective nightmares into the god Cacophony.
timeline.quote: It was Ashiok who masterminded the dark dreams of the polis, aided by Phenax

citation.text: "Cacophony", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Phenax owed Ashiok a favor and granted a boon of concealment from the gods.
relations.quote: to repay a favor the Planeswalker had done for the god.

citation.text: "Dreams of the City" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2014.

relations.quote: they made a bargain with Phenax

citation.text: "Ashiok", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Ephara", section "Relationships". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Katachthon Mountains", section "Locations in the Katachthon Mountains". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Phenax lingered as Ashiok was given free rein.
relations.quote: Ashiok was given free rein to continue their torment of the people of Theros

citation.text: "Kedarick VI", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Mogis respects Phenax for the chaos he causes.
relations.quote: Mogis holds respect for Phenax due to the chaos Phenax causes

citation.text: "Mogis", section "Influence and Goals". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: charged with dragging Phenax back to the Underworld
relations.quote: Tymaret has been charged with dragging the trickster god Phenax back to the Underworld

citation.text: "Odunos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: Ashiok and Phenax plagued both parties with nightmares

citation.text: "Returned", section "Iretis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: God of deception and lies on Theros, who strikes a deal with Ashiok to obtain a third city for the Returned.

citation.text: "Building Toward a Dream, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.
